description.value: A privately run lakeside fishing resort on Loon Lake in the South Cariboo, open May through Thanksgiving, with tent sites, flush washrooms, boat rentals, and a playground; the 18 km of gravel on Loon Lake Road is RV-accessible but will rattle a loaded bike. The lake is one of BC's few naturally stocked rainbow trout fisheries and the main draw.

address.value: 1820 Loon Lake Road, Cache Creek, BC V0K 1H1
